<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="metric-v1">
<h1>Metric v1</h1>
<p>Metric identifier:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>feature-align/1
</pre></div>
</div>
<section id="pipeline">
<h2>Pipeline</h2>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>NFC-normalize IPA.</p></li>
<li><p>Remove Unicode format (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Cf</span></code>) characters.</p></li>
<li><p>Ignore stress by default for broad pronunciation comparison.</p></li>
<li><p>Normalize tie-bar variants.</p></li>
<li><p>Apply sparse language-profile notation aliases.</p></li>
<li><p>Tokenize IPA into segment-like units.</p></li>
<li><p>Compare single segments using PanPhon articulatory feature vectors.</p></li>
<li><p>Align sequences with dynamic programming.</p></li>
<li><p>Permit sparse profile-defined N↔M equivalences.</p></li>
<li><p>Normalize raw cost by the maximum segment count.</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section id="costs">
<h2>Costs</h2>
<p>Default MVP costs:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>exact match             0
feature substitution    PanPhon-derived [0, 1]
insertion               1
deletion                1
profile equivalence     profile-defined [0, 1]
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The normalized pronunciation score is bounded to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[0,</span> <span class="pre">1]</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="interpreting-a-result">
<h2>Interpreting a result</h2>
<p>A <a class="reference internal" href="../api/"><span class="std std-doc"><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">DistanceResult</span></code></span></a> exposes the normalized <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">distance</span></code>, unnormalized <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">raw_cost</span></code>,
and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">denominator</span></code> used for normalization. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">raw_cost</span></code> is the alignment cost before
normalization; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">denominator</span></code> is the larger of the source and target segment counts. The
score is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">raw_cost</span> <span class="pre">/</span> <span class="pre">denominator</span></code>, with zero for two empty segment sequences, and is
bounded to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[0,</span> <span class="pre">1]</span></code>.</p>
<p>A zero score can result from canonicalization or a zero-cost profile equivalence, not just
identical input strings. Stress removal, notation normalization, and profile sequence
equivalences can make different strings score zero. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">phonodist</span></code> does not supply universal
decision thresholds; choose thresholds for the application and data being evaluated.</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">phonodist</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">pronunciation_distance</span>

<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">pronunciation_distance</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;p&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;p&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">distance</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mf">0.0</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="explanation-mode">
<h2>Explanation mode</h2>
<p>Score-only and traceback modes are intended to produce the same score. The default
score-only mode leaves <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">DistanceResult.operations</span></code> empty; pass <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">explain=True</span></code> to add the
deterministic alignment operations without changing the distance.</p>
</section>
<section id="important-limitation">
<h2>Important limitation</h2>
<p>This score is not a calibrated human perceptual-distance model. It is a deterministic
phonetic-feature comparison intended for validation and ranking.</p>
</section>
<section id="diagnostic-offsets">
<h2>Diagnostic offsets</h2>
<p><a class="reference internal" href="../api/"><span class="std std-doc"><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ParseDiagnostic.offset</span></code></span></a> is an index into the normalized working input after
outer delimiters and surrounding whitespace have been removed. It is not necessarily an
index into <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ParsedPronunciation.original</span></code> when those transformations changed the input.</p>
</section>
<section id="stress-scope">
<h2>Stress scope</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">feature-align/1</span></code> intentionally ignores primary and secondary stress. Stress-aware or
prosodic comparison is outside the v0.1 metric. The public pronunciation-distance API
rejects retained-stress scoring instead of treating stress markers as ordinary PanPhon
segments. Use <a class="reference internal" href="../COMPARISON/"><span class="std std-doc">Structural IPA comparison</span></a> for separate structural stress
diagnostics.</p>
</section>
<section id="structural-comparison">
<h2>Structural comparison</h2>
<p>The separate structural contract is identified as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ipa-compare/1</span></code>. It preserves primary
and secondary stress as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">StressEvent</span></code> values anchored in the stress-free canonical segment
sequence. Its result classifies exact, notation-only, stress-only, phonetic-equivalent, and
segmental differences, while embedding the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">feature-align/1</span></code> segmental result.</p>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ipa-compare/1</span></code> is a structural diagnostic, not a calibrated stress-distance model. It does
not alter pronunciations or determine expected stress. See <a class="reference internal" href="../COMPARISON/"><span class="std std-doc">Structural IPA comparison</span></a>.</p>
</section>
<section id="provenance-and-versioning">
<h2>Provenance and versioning</h2>
<p>Every <a class="reference internal" href="../api/"><span class="std std-doc"><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">DistanceResult</span></code></span></a> records the metric and metric version, selected profile and
profile version, and the PanPhon backend name, resolved version, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">spe+</span></code> feature set.
Bump the metric version when alignment, normalization, costs, or feature formulas change.
Bump a profile version when language-specific rules or costs change. Package-only fixes
that preserve scores do not require a metric version bump.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>

(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
